newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank says to maintain US operations.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank says to maintain US operations.

text.p: Asahi Bank Ltd said on Friday that it would maintain its U.S. operations despite fines imposed by the Federal Reserve for misconduct.
"We will maintain our business in the United States," a bank official said.
On Thursday, the Fed said that it had fined Asahi and its New York branch $5 million for misconduct.
Asahi said in a statement issued in Tokyo that it did not admit to any of the allegations but it had decided to pay the fines.
It said it had moved the senior officials at its New York branch and it had formulated measures to improve operations at the branch.

In November, Asahi president Shigehiko Yoshino told Japan"s Kyodo News Agency that bank employees had opened a sealed Fed inspection report regarding Asahi and he realised the bank might face penalties.
A senior official at Japan"s Ministry of Finance also said in November that the ministry would consider what course of action to take after U.S. authorities completed their investigations.
The bank stated that it incurred no losses in the case other than the payment of the fine.
